reason: B is the stronger proposal because it specifies a single element, concentration range, processing regime, baseline comparison, and falsification test, while boron segregation as an interface-cohesion strategy is more physically established than the vague Nb/precipitate mechanism in A. It still lacks cited supporting evidence, and boron-sensitive characterization such as APT or SIMS would be more credible than TEM/EDS, but its boride-formation boundary condition is explicit and testable.
